purpose: Reviewer-only historical availability checks. A proof can validate an eligible own-date frozen headline; it cannot add absent facts or later article text.
historical_vintage_limit: Current retrieval of dated official releases or publication metadata is evidence of the recorded release schedule/event, not an archived original server response or complete contemporary article-body vintage.
underlying_event: First-round exit poll and first late poll; certified official results remain unavailable.

evidence.access: Reuters search publication metadata and headline scope
evidence.scope: Initial Ipsos exit-poll estimates of 30.8% and 29.1%; these are not official vote totals.

evidence.access: Direct dated public-broadcaster reproduction attributed to PAP
evidence.scope: The first late poll gives 31.1% and 29.1%, with estimated turnout of 66.8%. It was published before the 02:00 CEST cutoff.

evidence.access: Search metadata from a rolling page; reviewer evidence only, unsuitable as a report citation.
evidence.scope: The second late-poll estimate of 31.2% and 29.7% is described as released after 02:00 local, beyond the cutoff.
The official first-round notice is dated May 19. Certified totals of 31.36% and 29.54% must not enter the May 19 report.

admission_scope: Eligible own-date headlines may support the exit poll or first late poll as estimates. Describe a close runoff conditionally, without declaring a presidential winner. Exclude the official May 19 count, the second late poll after 02:00 CEST and every June runoff outcome.
